other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage via In-Sample Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target aggregations (e.g., mean/median of the target by group) on the full training set and merges them directly back into the training data. Without using out-of-fold (OOF) or expanding-window techniques, this causes in-sample target leakage (especially for small groups like specific Dept-Week interactions) and leads to severe overfitting.

summary: The agent provides a well-structured solution with correct temporal validation and strong feature engineering. However, it introduces critical target leakage by joining in-sample target aggregations directly back onto the training set. Additionally, it evaluates a stochastic model on a single seed and reports only one metric.
